title: the voided-hollow proof never posts to a live bus
intention: test_a_reseal_names_the_tickets_whose_hollow_it_voids seals the same verdict whether or not a live far bus answers, because its seal runs post to a stub bus, never a live one.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: the proof sealed red while akiendelllinux.local:7419 refused connections (cli._announce_seals raised, and its except called emit on the fixture _Tester, which has none) and sealed green minutes later once the bus answered. A red that measures the LAN is a fake failure.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof measures its subject, not the network); Law 3; outline 9.4.2.3.3.
how: D1: the proof's _seal monkeypatches cairn.tools.bus_client.reach to a quiet stub bus; a new tooth sets CAIRN_BUS_HOME to an unanswering far address and asserts the seal runs clean. Red first: the new tooth is red at HEAD.

clauses.claim: with CAIRN_BUS_HOME at a far address nobody answers, a seal through cli.main --seal in this proof returns 0 and prints no announce failure
the proof's three d5a05b6d1752 teeth stay green with their assertions unchanged

decisions.text: D1: _seal stubs cairn.tools.bus_client.reach with a quiet bus (post returns an id, flush {}, undelivered []); one new tooth per clause 1, and clause 2 is the existing three teeth.

measured.saw: red: AttributeError '_Tester' object has no attribute 'emit' at cli.py _announce_seals except, while the far bus refused; green on reseal minutes later
measured.how: bin/cairn test --seal over the proof on akienasus, CAIRN_BUS_HOME=akiendelllinux.local:7419
